newsitem.title: UK: LME People - AMT recruits two account executives.
newsitem.headline: LME People - AMT recruits two account executives.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) ring dealer Amalgamated Metal Trading (AMT) said on Friday that Stephen Hardcastle and Bob Bridges had joined them as senior account executives.
"Both men have spent most of their career with Rudolf Wolff, although they have spent the last year working with Sogemin Metals," AMT said in a release.
AMT Managing Director Keith Gaunt added that he was delighted to have been able to add their considerable knowledge and experience to AMT's client liaison team.
